# Thorne

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c15 P8](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0008)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolteacher  <sub>[v1 c15 P8](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0008)</sub>

## Appearance

Agnes Thorne is an intelligent, refined, and compassionate young woman. She has light curly hair, captivating eyes, and wears stylish dresses with large puffed sleeves.

_Sources: [v1 c17 P8](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0008), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)_

## Personality

Miss Thorne possesses a gentle, refined manner and an intelligent, empathetic approach to teaching. She excels at capturing the affection of her students while encouraging their intellectual and moral growth, preferring clear explanations over harsh discipline. She is supportive, inventive, and dedicated to her pupils, choosing to stay in Brierley out of deep interest in their progress.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P89](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0089), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 c24 P6](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0006)_

## Traits

- Intelligent  <sub>[v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)</sub>
- Refined and gentle  <sub>[v1 c24 P2](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0002)</sub>
- Encouraging and sympathetic  <sub>[v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)</sub>

## Abilities

- Skilled and engaging teacher  <sub>[v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 c24 P6](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0006)</sub>
- Effective classroom manager without relying on harsh punishment  <sub>[v1 c15 P89](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0089), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)</sub>

## Goals

- To draw out the finest intellectual and moral qualities in her students  <sub>[v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)</sub>
- To guide her advanced class through their preparation for the Regent's entrance exam  <sub>[v1 c30 P14](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0014), [v1 c30 P29](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0029)</sub>

## History

Miss Agnes Thorne was hired as the new teacher for the Brierley schoolhouse, becoming the first female teacher employed in the village. Upon taking her position in the autumn, she quickly earned the devotion of her students, including Nell Harcourt and Hugh Carrow, through her gentle manners, clear explanations, and engaging curriculum. She introduced innovative practices into the school routine, such as biweekly recitation afternoons, nature field days, physical culture exercises, and essay-writing assignments. When presented with an opportunity to teach at a grade school in her home district, Miss Thorne chose to remain at Brierley out of dedication to her pupils. Later in the year, she organized a school concert for Christmas Night to raise funds for a schoolhouse flag, and she formed an advanced after-school class to prepare high-achieving students for the Regent’s Academy entrance examination.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P30](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0030), [v1 c15 P32](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0032), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 c24 P6](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0006), [v1 c24 P8](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0008), [v1 c24 P10](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0010), [v1 c30 P14](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0014)_

## Background by volume

- Hired by the Brierley school trustees as the series' first female teacher in Brierley  <sub>[v1 c15 P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013)</sub>
- Received a job offer in her home district's grade school but declined it to remain with her Brierley students  <sub>[v1 c15 P30](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0030), [v1 c15 P32](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0032)</sub>

## Quotes

> Indeed, I believe I shall. I considered accepting a position at a different school, yet my decision is to return to Brierley. Honestly, my interest in my students here has developed to such an extent that departing proved impossible. Therefore, I will remain and guide you to the end.  <sub>[v1 c15 P32](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0032)</sub>
